hooks.name: Brick Agent Onboarding
hooks.description: Reminds each new session of the one-brick-per-agent coordination rules for parallel scaffolding.

action.prompt: If this session will scaffold or modify a brick: first confirm that its own GitHub issue and GitHub Projects roadmap entry identify the family and intended owning crate. Then claim exactly one crates/<brick>/ folder and stay in it. Do not touch setup-owned root Cargo.toml workspace members, Makefile quality-matrix lines, scripts/validate_brick_registry.py adapter mappings/status-only allowlist, or matching validator tests unless you are the designated setup agent. See .kiro/steering/multi-agent-coordination.md.
